class.name: FoxCharacterAccessories
class.brief_description: Manages dynamically equipping rigid and skinned cosmetic items.

method.name: equip_rigid_accessory
method.description: Attaches a rigid item to any bone by its string name.

method.name: has_rigid_accessory_in_slot
method.description: Returns true if a rigid accessory could be found under a bone.

method.name: get_rigid_accessories_in_slot
method.description: Returns all rigid accessories assigned to a bone.

method.name: empty_rigid_accessory_slot
method.description: Removes all rigid accessories assigned to a bone.

method.name: clear_all_rigid_accessories
method.description: Clears all rigid accessories from their slots. This effectively wipes the character back to having no rigid accessories.

method.name: equip_skinned_accessory
method.description: Equips a raw .gltf scene wrapper and automatically re-routes its internal meshes to use the skeleton assigned to this FoxCharacterAccessories, [br]Keeps track of the skinned accessory by the slot_name provided so that it can be found or removed later.

method.name: has_skinned_accessory_slot
method.description: Returns true if we have a value for that skinned slot.

method.name: get_skinned_accessory_slots
method.description: Returns dictionary showing all skinned slots. Each key is the name of the slot and the value is the Node its assigned to.

method.name: empty_skinned_accessory_slot
method.description: Removes a skinned accessory by its slot name.

method.name: clear_all_skinned_accessories
method.description: Clears all skinned accessories from their slots. This effectively wipes the character back to having no skinned accessories.

method.name: clear_all_accessories
method.description: Clears all accessories from their slots. This effectively wipes the character back to having no accessories.

members.member: The skeleton that the rigid accessories will attach to and the skinned accessories will deform to.
Tracks all instances of skinned accessories.
Tracks all instances of rigid accessories.

signal.name: rigid_equipped
signal.description: Emitted when a rigid accessory is equipped.

signal.name: skinned_equipped
signal.description: Emitted when a skinned accessory is added.

signal.name: rigid_removed
signal.description: Emitted when a rigid accessory is removed.

signal.name: skinned_removed
signal.description: Emitted when a skinned accessory is removed.
